title: Insurance Claim Services Final Mold Supplement: Surface Lines by Growth Location
content:
| Growth location on the Mold Remediation job | Surface lines claimed |
|---|---|
| attic or crawlspace | the soda blasting and dry ice blasting lines billed on the job |
| HVAC system | the duct cleaning, air handler cleaning and coil cleaning lines billed on the job |
| living area or basement | the wire-brush sanding and encapsulation lines billed on the job |

**Rule.** For the final mold supplement of Insurance Claim Services, the surface treatment is taken as follows: for growth in an attic or crawlspace, the soda blasting and dry ice blasting lines billed on the job; for growth in the HVAC system, the duct cleaning, air handler cleaning and coil cleaning lines billed on the job; for growth in a living area or basement, the wire-brush sanding and encapsulation lines billed on the job.

The job is the Mold Remediation job awaiting clearance; lines are taken at the amount billed.

*Hypothetical:* attic growth with soda blasting of 640.00 and dry ice blasting of 310.00 billed: 950.00. HVAC growth with duct cleaning 540.00, air handler cleaning 410.00 and coil cleaning 245.00: 1195.00.
